snippet.title: Dear Me, I was... Accolade Trailer
snippet.description:
The interactive story “Dear me, I was...” comes to PC Steam, Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android on February 12, 2026 with pre-orders available today!

Link: https://www.arcsystemworks.fr/games/dear-me-i-was/

We are excited to announce the Nintendo Switch 2 title “Dear me, I was...” will be released on Steam, Nintendo Switch, iOS, and Android platforms on February 12th, 2026!

The trailer revealed today includes some of the gorgeous artwork and scenes that moved the hearts of many, including media all around the world.

Follow us on our social media for more informations about the game and other Arc System Works titles.
